purpose: A portable execution contract for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Cline, Grok, Antigravity, OpenHands, Aider-style loops, and Starlight queues.

evidence: tests, type checks, lint, build, smoke, visual QA, deployment readback, or doc consistency

routingRules.singleAgentDefault: Use one coding agent for scoped work where the context fits and validation is local.
subagentWhen: research would consume large context but can return a compact answer
the work is separable and low collision
queueWhen: multiple worker lanes need bounded artifacts
human synthesis is required after independent findings
doNotUse: parallel edits to the same working tree
unbounded agents that can publish, spend, delete, invite, rotate secrets, or promote production

sourceInfluences.name: AGENTS.md
sourceInfluences.lesson: Use one predictable project instruction file as portable base.

sourceInfluences.name: OpenAI Codex AGENTS.md
sourceInfluences.lesson: Layer global and project instructions with local precedence.

sourceInfluences.name: Claude Code hooks and skills
sourceInfluences.lesson: Use skills for reusable procedures and hooks for deterministic lifecycle gates.

sourceInfluences.name: mini-swe-agent
sourceInfluences.lesson: Prefer simple, inspectable loops and independent command execution over ornate scaffolding.

sourceInfluences.name: SWE-agent
sourceInfluences.lesson: Treat the agent-computer interface and feedback format as core product surface.

sourceInfluences.name: OpenHands
sourceInfluences.lesson: Use remote or sandbox workspaces for always-on or multi-agent work.

sourceInfluences.name: Aider
sourceInfluences.lesson: Maintain repo maps, git visibility, and automatic lint/test feedback.

sourceInfluences.name: GitHub Copilot customizations
sourceInfluences.lesson: Project rules, path-scoped instructions, hooks, workflows, and skills should be machine-discoverable.
